notes.title: Beat Flip Game Release
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! I'm excited to be releasing my first game on Steam, a game I've called Beat Flip. It's a pretty casual game, best played on a couch with a controller if you ask me.
In this game you flip tiles and shift them to match a pattern every beat of the music. You get three lives, and you keep going until you lose or end the game. It's pretty addicting if I do say so myself, I spent a lot of precious dev time trying to beat my high score!
A bit of backstory:
I've been making games for years, but this is my first game I've totally finished. It was an idea I got from a jam, that I got really passionate about and I really wanted to make it into a polished and complete product after the jam was over. I'm hoping to get it on mobile eventually if it does well enough.
Anyway that's enough from me. The game drops on September 8th and I hope everyone that plays it enjoys it as much as I do (or more). I'll see you at release!
-Kask
